evidence.note: resultContractFor(crossShard bool) now renders a distinct contract per pack kind; crossShardContractBody names cross-shard.<planHash>.result.json, kind "cross-shard" and an empty shardId, which matches the validator in internal/reviewmanifest/manifest.go (KindCrossShard, MatchesPlan on planHash, and the "cross-shard result must not name a shard" blocker).
shardPack calls resultContractFor(false) and crossShardPack calls resultContractFor(true); no pack kind emits the other's wording.

shardPack validates every chunk against the measured diff (missing file, ByteStart > ByteEnd, ByteEnd past diff length) and returns an error rather than emitting an empty block, so no pack can present truncated content as a complete diff.

Write uses rename-aside then rename-in then remove-aside, clears a stale .aside first, removes the staging directory on every failure branch, and returns a rollback that restores the previous pack set; isPrunable at line 315 also reclaims orphaned .aside directories.
GC re-applies Discover's content-based freshness test via resultIsCurrent before removing a result file, so a file the gate just counted is not collected because of its name.

Validation evidence: the shard's source file is covered by a 1175-line test file added in the same diff, including TestCrossShardPackStatesItsOwnContract which pins both the cross-shard contract wording and that the shard pack keeps the shard contract.

Checked the whole shard for rubric blockers: no eval or other unsafe execution, no TODO/FIXME markers, no truncated diff context (single part 1/1 chunk, 22133 of 60000 bytes), and no duplication of an existing inventoried path -- shardpack is a new package and the only in-repo references to resultContractFor are here and in its test.
